fact: The article states that the National Cyber Security Authority (NCSA) acts as the supervisory authority for personal data protection and privacy under the Data Protection Act, as Rwanda observed Data Privacy Week on 26-30 January 2026.
The East African Community says Rwanda is among five of its eight Partner States that had established dedicated data protection authorities.
Digital Policy Alert says the National Cyber Security Authority oversees data governance and set up its Data Protection Office in 2022, which issues guidelines.
Digital Policy Alert says there are no public, official sources on enforcement action by the National Cyber Security Authority or its Data Protection Office.
